description: Convert a NIfTI volume into an OME-Zarr multiscale pyramid, exposing both the on-disk OME-Zarr store and the ngff-zarr multiscale model.

scales.description: Number of pyramid levels to generate.

pyramid.description: OME-Zarr (OME-NGFF) multiscale store written to disk.

multiscale.description: The ngff-zarr multiscale data model describing the pyramid (named dims, scale/translation, units).
